known_limitation: Approved local PRG backport is installed. Functional integration is not cryptographic certification; trusted host and honest protocol parties, no hostile transport or host compromise protection.
new_engineering_decisions: Reuse full-size model/training configuration and original full-size manifests without changing PRG/quantisation.
Use the upstream SecAggPlusWorkflow and secaggplus_mod with approved pinned PRG backport, wrapped only with guards; do not change further cryptography or dependencies inside the training runner.
Require exactly three participants at all four protocol stages; abort on missing reply or aborted workflow, with no plaintext fallback.

Only public cohort identifiers, counts, global-input fingerprints and completed-step acknowledgements accompany masked training replies. No client output fingerprints, losses, gradients or update summaries are forwarded.
Raw parameter range guard is local and reports only success/failure. It is stricter than the stock weighted-parameter quantizer and rejects clipping.

Stock secure workflow passes the same recovered aggregate in each legacy FitRes. Check equality, then cast this one already-weighted aggregate to float32 for the unchanged model; do not FedAvg individual updates again.
Numerical oracle is a separate in-memory protocol run on public small toy tensors. No benchmark data, reused secrets or update inspection are allowed in this oracle.
Routine evaluation scalar metrics remain explicitly outside aggregation protection; per-session losses remain in client-local files, not the exported report.
The matched live C run has no independent plaintext-update oracle on the server. Its numeric correctness evidence is the separate toy protocol oracle plus live boundary/cohort/finite checks.
Engineering success never sets privacy/security approval to true; local backport requires documented security review and full-size checks before main-study freeze.
Existing B runtime patches 1.0.1 through 1.0.5 are retained. No new loopback ports or elevated privileges.
pinned_crypto_unchanged_note: The inherited false value refers to changes from stock Flower1.22.0; this full-size release does not change the already accepted local backport.
